scope: Retire the post-NGE Game Update 10 four-map queued/warped/level-gated battlefield system and its orphaned token-reward vendors while preserving the PRE-CU open-world battlefield implementation, faction standing, mission terminals, later-zone scenery assets, and the authored vendor NPC/conversation presentation.

findings: The pinned Publish 14 reference creates open-world battlefield markers and no-build/no-spawn active areas on eight original planets; it has no four-map cross-server queue, invitation, warp, level-75 admission, or token-reward controller.
The later pvp_battlefields table names four queued maps, and systems.gcw.player_pvp enforces level 75, 4v4-to-16v16 queue/invitation flow, warp admission, scoreboards, and battlefield tokens.

Two later Talus and Rori spawners still create GU10 battlefield token vendors after the controllers and token earners are retired; their generic vendor script and conversations expose the orphaned token reward inventory to players with persisted later-era tokens.
The retained systems.battlefield implementation is a distinct open-world region game using battlefield.tab, faction selection, battlefield structures, and PRE-CU faction-standing rewards.
The retained War Terminal still exposed a queue action after the queued player handler was detached, leaving a dead interaction and a cached intelpad action that could survive older sessions.

The retained battlefield_communication_run runner buff has one authored persistent row, one battlefieldCommuncationsGlow effect mapping, one controller producer, and thirteen read-side blockers across stealth, PvP, player, and terminal code. Generic player buff admission and the add handler remained reachable after the queued controllers were retired.

Exact player-only admission, lifecycle cleanup, and an add-handler guard now prevent the obsolete runner from stripping PRE-CU invisibility or blocking retained player movement and stealth paths, while the authored row, producer, consumers, non-player compatibility, and unguarded remove-side cleanup remain intact.
